name: School of Management, Pandit Deendayal Energy University

programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeNote: Tentative fee for Batch 2027-29 (MBA Admission Rules 2027): tuition Rs 3,50,000 x 4 tranches = 14,00,000 + university enrolment & examination fee 5,000 x 4 = 20,000 -> Rs 14,20,000. Excludes AC hostel Rs 1,10,000/yr, mess Rs 62,000/yr and refundable deposits (hostel 5,000, security 10,000, library 3,000); all-in total Rs 17,82,000. NRI tuition US$ 26,000 total. Subject to revision.
programs.intakeNote: 260 seats for the 2027 intake (besides supernumerary) per MBA Admission Rules 2027. ACPC's 2026-27 CoE list showed intake 200 (62 via ACPC) for the previous cycle.
programs.salaryYear: Final placements 'last year' as stated in MBA 2026 brochure (batch not named)
programs.placementNote: Official SoM-PDEU MBA 2026 brochure, 'MBA final placements @ SoM in last year': 100% placements, average CTC INR 9.70 LPA, top-25% average 10.70 LPA, highest 24.10 LPA. Median not published; batch year not stated in the brochure.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting on CAT 2026 / XAT 2027 / NMAT 2026 / GMAT score
Group Discussion, Written Ability Test, Personal Interview
selectionProcess.detail: Rolling GD/WAT/PI 15 Mar - 15 Apr 2027 at SoM-PDEU or other select locations.

selectionProcess.name: Final selection matrix
selectionProcess.weightage: Test score 40%, GD 10%, PI 20%, Work experience (min 12 months) 10%, Diversity 10%, Academics 10%

selectionWeightage.note: MBA Admission Rules 2027; WAT is qualifying only.

keyDates.notes: Last date for application 31 Mar 2027; GD/WAT/PI 15 Mar - 15 Apr 2027 (rolling, tentative); selected list by 20 Apr 2027. CAT 2026 on 29 Nov 2026.

nirf.note: Ranked entity is Pandit Deendayal Energy University (the university). Campus is at Raisan, Gandhinagar (adjacent to Ahmedabad), not within Ahmedabad city.
